name: The Girl I Like Is a Freak Like Me?!
source:
Nishino Amane is in love with the beautiful head of her school's student council, Takatsuki Mizore, and she's not the only one. Mizore is easily the most popular girl at St Verbena's, which is a prestigious all-girls boarding school, and she even has her own fanclub.

Amane is sure there's no way an intelligent, accomplished young woman like Mizore would ever look at her twice...

Until she realises Mizore is a huge fan of her favourite light novel series, Elf Forest, and she even ships the same pairing that Amane does! Amane's heart soars, as she realises that the girl she likes might not be so untouchable after all.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5305440/The_Girl_I_Like_Is_a_Freak_Like_Me/]Steam[/url]]
